evidence.output_tail: - `PATCH /api/draws/[drawId]` with `status: APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS`: stores `conditionalApprovalNote`, `heldAmount`, sets `approvedAt`, emails GC - `PATCH` with `action: MARK_CONDITIONS_MET` (GC-only): sets `conditionsMetAt`, emails lender - `GET` now returns `conditionalApprovalNote`, `heldAmount`, `conditionsMetAt`  **Emails:** - `sendDrawConditionallyApprovedEmail` — GC notified with conditions note and CTA - `sendDrawConditionsMetEmail` — lender notified with Fund Draw CTA  **Schema/Mi
